name: Insurance quote engine
note: An SME business-insurance platform whose quote engine was rebuilt for near-instant quotes, with an insurer API integration, a payment gateway and sign-in shared across subdomains. Built at Logix Built Solutions.
problem: Quotes took more than 10 minutes of synchronous lookups and recalculation. People abandoned the flow at the moment they were most ready to buy, so speed was the conversion problem, not a detail.

approach.title: Profiling
approach.text: Instrumented the flow and found repeated expensive lookups blocking every quote.

approach.title: Caching
approach.text: A Redis layer for rate tables and partial results, so repeated work is skipped.

approach.title: Parallel calls
approach.text: The four insurer API calls that ran one after another now run at the same time.

approach.title: Database tuning
approach.text: Indexes and selective denormalisation on the data each quote depends on.

approach.title: Streamed progress
approach.text: The UI streams progress, so a quote feels instant while it finishes.

features: Quotes for liability, property and employee health cover
